correctness.rationale: Exact mixed Gaussian monomial norms yield the kernel series. An order-one finite-zero Hadamard factorization would force a pure Gaussian exponential, contradicted by coefficient limits; hence infinitely many zeros. For small admixture an absolutely convergent exponential cascade permits a quantitative zero-free half-plane and a Rouché-isolated simple negative zero with an explicit first correction; the two bounds give the sharp minimal-modulus logarithmic scale. Direct differentiation gives the global complex-Hessian lower bound a-Delta*eta/e and uniform C^m potential proximity. A standard-library checker supplied finite consistency tests, not infinite certification.

value.rationale: Global Lu Qi-Keng zero geometry is a natural invariant unavailable from local kernel estimates. The complete family of nontrivial Gaussian mixtures is a systematic instability statement; a sharp log(1/epsilon)/[a(1-a/b)] escape law quantifies where zeros are first forced as the perturbation vanishes. Global strong-curvature and every-C^m proximity show the effect persists in the smoothest nondegenerate weight regime, providing a useful boundary for hypotheses on weighted-Fock kernel global nonvanishing.
